WITH per AS (
  SELECT period_start_date ps, period_end_date pe, weeks_in_period wk, fiscal_year fy, fiscal_period fp
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5
),
stock AS (
  SELECT p.category, sum(f.closing_value) stock_value, sum(f.closing_units) stock_units
  FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key, per
  WHERE f.week_ending_date = per.pe AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
sales AS (
  SELECT p.category, sum(f.standard_cost) cogs, sum(f.quantity) units, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN f.standard_cost ELSE 0 END) cogs_store, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) units_store
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key, per
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
rets AS (
  SELECT p.category, sum(r.standard_cost_returned) cogs_ret, sum(r.quantity_returned) units_ret, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN r.standard_cost_returned ELSE 0 END) cogs_ret_store, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN r.quantity_returned ELSE 0 END) units_ret_store
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key, per
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT per.fy fiscal_year, per.fp fiscal_period, st.category,
  round(st.stock_value,2) stock_value,
  round((sa.cogs - coalesce(rt.cogs_ret,0))/per.wk,2) weekly_cogs_net,
  round(st.stock_value / ((sa.cogs - coalesce(rt.cogs_ret,0))/per.wk),2) woc_value_net,
  round(st.stock_value / (sa.cogs/per.wk),2) woc_value_gross,
  round(st.stock_value / ((sa.cogs_store - coalesce(rt.cogs_ret_store,0))/per.wk),2) woc_value_storeonly,
  round(st.stock_units / ((sa.units - coalesce(rt.units_ret,0))/per.wk),2) woc_units_net,
  round(st.stock_units / ((sa.units_store - coalesce(rt.units_ret_store,0))/per.wk),2) woc_units_storeonly
FROM stock st JOIN sales sa USING(category) LEFT JOIN rets rt USING(category), per
ORDER BY st.category

WITH per AS (SELECT period_start_date ps, period_end_date pe, weeks_in_period wk, fiscal_year fy, fiscal_period fp FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5),
stock AS (SELECT p.category, sum(f.closing_value) stock_value FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key, per WHERE f.week_ending_date=per.pe AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
sales AS (SELECT p.category, sum(f.standard_cost) cogs FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key, per WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
rets AS (SELECT p.category, sum(r.standard_cost_returned) cogs_ret FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key, per WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT per.fy AS fiscal_year, per.fp AS fiscal_period, st.category, round(st.stock_value / ((sa.cogs - coalesce(rt.cogs_ret,0)) / per.wk), 1) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM stock st JOIN sales sa USING(category) LEFT JOIN rets rt USING(category), per ORDER BY st.category
